notes.title: Small Bugfix Update - Patch Notes (v010)
notes.notes:
Fixed achievements not activating if the player quit the credits early.
Fixed lock not unlocking in some cases when placing a rotated button on the unlocking area.

notes.title: UPDATE: Added keyboard support to the demo!
notes.notes:
Hi! Just updated the demo with a few bug fixes and keyboard support.


Added keyboard support

Use WASD or arrows to control the player, but only if the button is available on the screen. A list of the shortcuts can now be viewed in the pause menu.

Player movement: WASD/Arrows
Undo/Redo: Z/X
Restart: R

Pink Undo/Redo: SHIFT + Z/X
Pink Restart: SHIFT + R
